claim: In mm/memory.c (thp_swapin_suitable_orders) and mm/zswap.c (zswap_load), when all swap slots in an aligned order-2 or order-4 range reside in zswap, thp_swapin_suitable_orders permits the high-order folio and zswap_load assembles contiguous compressed slots into the allocated high-order folio, installing them in do_swap_page with a single set_ptes() call under one page table lock hold.
falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.
